goal: Add the per-location Competitor Delta line to the weekly Insights digest using the primary tracked keyword's persisted Competitor pack, with the Auto-default rival's review-count gap and review velocity since our last check.
non_goals: Named rival persistence, owner-scoped API, or settings UI from ticket #546
Changing RankingTrackingScheduler cadence or making new SerpAPI calls
Rating- or rank-based Competitor Delta copy
Schema changes, migrations, feature flags, or new dependencies
user_visible_behavior: A configured location with current and preceding matching Competitor pack snapshots sees a clearly labeled auto-selected rival's review velocity since our last check and the current review-count gap.
A configured location with a current Competitor pack but no preceding match sees the current review-count gap without velocity.
A configured location without a usable Competitor pack sees one cadence-safe teaser line that RepWorth is watching the primary tracked keyword and will report after the next check.
A location without a primary tracked keyword or ranking search location omits the Competitor Delta line.
Owner-picked Named rival dropout and fallback remain governed by the locked #532 semantics and become observable when #546 supplies the persisted pick.
invariants: Gap equals rival review_count minus the location's own review_count from the same snapshot; rating and rank never affect the displayed gap.
The Auto-default rival is the smallest positive review-count gap; when none is ahead, use the closest non-positive challenger, with ties broken by rank_position then stable place identity.
Competitor Delta stays strictly scoped by business_id, primary tracked keyword, and current search_location.
Coordinate-backed search_location keys preserve the NUMERIC text representation read from Postgres so they exactly match RankingTrackingWorker's persisted series key.
The read path makes no external call and does not mutate competitor or ranking state.
competitor_snapshots.rating is parsed from the Postgres.js NUMERIC string into a finite number or null at the read boundary.
All rival names and teaser keywords are HTML-escaped before rendering.
edge_cases: A zero review-count gap is a valid Auto-default rival when no competitor is ahead.
A null rank_position sorts after every numeric rank before the place_id tie breaker.
Rows with null review_count, null place_id, an empty title, or is_self=true cannot become the Auto-default rival.
A snapshot without a self row or with a null self review_count cannot produce gap math and degrades to the teaser.
A current rival without a preceding place_id match produces gap-only copy.
Negative velocity is rendered as lost reviews since our last check; zero velocity is rendered as no new reviews since our last check.
A rival behind the location preserves the signed rival-minus-self gap instead of taking an absolute value.
A changed primary keyword or search_location starts a new comparison series naturally.
Malformed or non-finite NUMERIC rating text is normalized to null and never affects v1 selection or copy.
